notable_absence.finding: No Enterprise/Community edition badge on this page - consistent with the rest of this batch.

cross_component_finding: Confirms the managementPlaneCredential vs. dataPlaneCredential split flagged in data-api-intro.json: every Management API call on this page authenticates with `-H "Authorization: Bearer $apiKeySecret"` (a Management API key secret), while the Data API call used later in this same page to validate the connection ('Test the Data API node') authenticates with `-u $USER:$PASSWORD` (the cluster access credential, HTTP Basic). Both mechanisms appear side-by-side in the same procedure, on the same page, confirming these are two deliberately distinct, non-overlapping credential axes for the same feature (configure vs. use).
cross_product_finding: GCP is conspicuously absent - private endpoints for the Data API are documented only for AWS and Azure ('Currently, private endpoints for the Data API are available using Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure' per data-api-private.md), even though Couchbase Capella otherwise supports GCP as a deployment CSP elsewhere in the docs set. Flagging as a coverage gap rather than an ontology finding.
